Laptop Computers

Shop our best laptops and notebooks from Dell.

AI PCs
AI PCs are defined as PCs and workstations equipped with a Microsoft Copilot Key (required only for laptops) and a designated NPU or AI chip.
AI Workstations
Workstations equipped for AI development should include a NVIDIA RTX™ 5000 GPU or higher.
Copilot+ PCs
Copilot+ PCs are the most performant AI PCs with an NPU running at 40+ TOPS enabling unique AI experiences. Minimum 256GB storage and 16GB memory required for Copilot+ PCs. Some Copilot+ PC experiences require free updates continuing to roll out through early 2026. Timing varies by device and region.

Learn More About Dell Laptops

Dell offers a comprehensive range of laptops designed to cater to diverse needs. Equipped with Intel or AMD processors, Dell laptops often boast cutting-edge technology, high-resolution displays, and robust build quality. For gaming enthusiasts, the Alienware series provides a formidable lineup with dedicated graphics cards and advanced cooling systems, delivering an immersive gaming experience. Whether for work, entertainment, or gaming, Dell laptops consistently strive to offer a harmonious blend of performance, design, and reliability. ...

FAQs:

To choose the right Dell laptop, consider your specific requirements such as performance, storage, display size, and budget. Our product pages provide detailed specifications to help you make an informed decision. Additionally, feel free to reach out to our customer support for personalized assistance.

Dell regularly offer exclusive laptop deals to provide our customers with great value. Keep an eye on our promotions and special offers on the laptops page to ensure you don't miss out on any discounts or bundled packages.

Dell laptops are compatible with a wide range of external accessories and peripherals such as printers, monitors, and external storage devices. Ensure that the accessories are compatible with your specific laptop model, and refer to the user manual for connectivity options.

Dell is committed to sustainability, and our laptops incorporate eco-friendly practices. We prioritize energy efficiency, use recycled materials, and offer recycling programs for old electronics. For detailed information on our sustainability initiatives, you can visit our environmental sustainability page on the Dell website.

Dell offers a range of laptops designed specifically for gaming, featuring powerful graphics, high refresh rates, and advanced cooling systems. Look for the "Gaming Laptops" section on our laptops page to explore gaming-specific models.

Marketing Campaign Claims/Legal Disclaimers

1. Returns The 30-day return period is calculated from invoice date. Exceptions to Dell's standard return policy still apply, and certain products are not eligible for return at any time. See dell.com/returnpolicy.

2. Expedited Delivery: Expedited Delivery not available on certain TVs, monitors, batteries and adapters, and is available in Continental (except Alaska) U.S. only. Other exceptions apply. Not valid for resellers and/or online auctions. Offers subject to change, not combinable with all other offers.

3. Onsite Service After Remote Diagnosis and Other Important Information: *On-site Service or Advanced Exchange Service after remote diagnosis: (a) On-site Service after remote diagnosis is determined by the online or phone technician, and may involve customer access to the inside of the system and multiple extended sessions. If the issue is covered by the Limited Hardware Warranty and cannot be resolved remotely, the technician and/or replacement part will be dispatched, usually in 1 or 2 business days, following the completion of the remote diagnosis. The customer must return the original hardware to Dell according to the rules specified. On-site service is provided by Dell Marketing L.P; Availability varies. Other conditions apply. (b) Advanced Exchange Service replaces hardware after remote diagnosis. The customer must return the original hardware to Dell according to the rules specified. Advanced Exchange Service is subject to country availability. (c) For complete details about On-site Service or Advanced Exchange Service, see dell.com/servicecontracts[ ↑ ].
